assertions.name: eigenphase_u_series_extracted
assertions.source: cos(α−bℏ²/2) Taylor-expanded in u = b·ℏ² to order 3; coefficients are exact symbolic radicals, directly comparable to the ladder c_k.

assertions.name: eigenphase_a1_equals_neg_sqrt3_over_12
assertions.source: Numeric u¹ coefficient matches the exact radical -√3/12.

assertions.name: eigenphase_a2_equals_neg_11_32_minus_sqrt3_over_12
assertions.source: Numeric u² coefficient matches the exact radical -11/32 - √3/12.

assertions.name: eigenphase_a1_nonzero_falsifies_eigenphase_eq_f
assertions.source: The u¹ coefficient is nonzero (a_1 = -√3/12), but the Q_β ladder has no c_1 rung — this is the falsification of the 'eigenphase = f' hypothesis at order u¹.

assertions.name: symbolic_numeric_crosscheck_agree
assertions.source: Symbolic-exact path certified 3 leading coefficients in radicals; each agrees with the numeric path to < 1e-30.

description: Taylor expansion of the N=1 cos eigenphase scaling cos(α − bℏ²/2) in the ladder variable u = b·ℏ², to determine which Q_β ladder coefficients c_k the single-block eigenphase generates exactly and where it breaks. Tests whether the eigenphase DERIVES c_2 = -1 (currently proved via a separate Kashiwara argument) and quantifies its prediction for c_3 vs the empirical value at both q₀ anchors — fixing the size of the multi-Wedderburn-block refinement the true scaling map f must add. 1ppQ-Q_β keystone (probe-qbeta-habiro-element-search). No fitting; eigenphase is the witness-cited closed form.

symbolic_numeric_crosscheck.note: Symbolic-exact path (eigenphase_u_coeffs_symbolic) certifies the leading coefficients in exact radicals; numeric path (eigenphase_u_coeffs) covers all orders. Both share the exact symbolic ε-series. Kept dual for later verification.

interpretation.reason: cos(α−bℏ²/2) has a nonzero u^1 coefficient (a_1 = -√3/12 ≈ -0.1443); the Q_β ladder starts at u² (c_2·u², no c_1 term). So the eigenphase carries an odd-order correction the ladder lacks — it is NOT the c_k generating factor by itself.
interpretation.new_constraint_on_f: the true scaling map f must (a) cancel the u^1 term and (b) give u² coefficient = -1 exactly; the u^1 cancellation is the concrete new structural constraint
interpretation.tier: eigenphase: proved closed form; eigenphase=f: falsified at u^1
